violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: interior of hot holding boxes and outsides of stainless steel containers.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. ENSURE NON- FOOD CONTACT SURFACES ARE CLEANED TO THE SIGHT AND TOUCH BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. OBSERVED HAND WASHING SINKS IN SUITE 100 AND 200 TO NOT BE PROVIDED WITH PAPER TOWELS.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI: PAPER TOWELS PROVIDED DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED MILK IN THE ONE-DOOR RESIDENTIAL COOLER IN SUITE 200 AT 51F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: MILK DISPOSED OF/PIC RE-EDUCATED.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Rooms Enclosed
violations.observation: Toilet room door is not provided with a self-closing door. OBSERVED STAFF BATHROOM DOOR TO NOT BE SELF-CLOSING.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a self-closing hinge or closing mechanism for the toilet room door. CDI: MAINTENANCE FIXED DOOR DURING INSPECTION TO ENSURE IT CLOSES AUTOMATICALLY.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed a small spray bottle of white board cleaner being stored with food and food equipment
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. PIC MOVED THE CLEANER TO THE OFFICE. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO STORE ALL CLEANING PRODUCTS AWAY FROM FOOD.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution. A chemical dish machine was observed at less than 50ppm in the Rehoboth Neighborhood.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCONTINUE THE USE OF THIS DISH MACHINE UNTIL IT IS OPERATIONAL. PIC INSTRUCTED MAINTENANCE TO REPAIR THE MACHINE. MAINTENANCE BEGANE REPAIRS DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: deli ham in the walk in refrigerator
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED THE DELI HAM.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed two bags of onions being stored directly on the floor of the walk in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC MOVED THE ONIONS TO AN ELEVATED POSITION. OBTAIN NSF APPROVED SHELVING UNITS OR DUNNAGE RACKS TO KEEP FOOD OFF OF THE FLOOR. PLEASE MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed a small container laying in the panko bulk bin and a soup ladle laying in the sugar bulk bin.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC REMOVED THE SMALL CONTAINER FROM THE BULK BIN AND PROPERLY STORED THE LADLE. SCOOPS WITH HANDLES CAN BE STORED IN BULK BINS WITH THEIR HANDLES STICKING UPWARDS.
